title: The Who Sell Out
notes:
Original UK mono release in fully-laminated cover, on black/silver-print Track Record labels.
First catalogue number on cover rear and labels, 2nd on cover spine.

℗ 1967

Manufactured in Great Britain by Polydor Records Ltd., London
Printed and made by Ernest J. Day & Co. Ltd. London, W.11. Patent Pending
Made In Gt.Britain

Publishing:
• Essex Music - A1, A2, B2, B4.
• Fabulous Music - A3 to A7, B1 B3, B5, B6.

The first 500 were issued with a 6 panel fold out poster.

Runouts are stamped.
